# std/mul

> * : multiplication

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/mul.pkg) · translated by [bintables/mul](../bintables/mul.md) · translated by [ctables/mul](../ctables/mul.md) · translated by [webtables/mul](../webtables/mul.md)

Multiplication. Overflow wraps around (two's complement).

```
print 6 * 7     // 42
```

Infix, precedence 60, left-associative. Both operands must be `int`; the
result is `int`.

## Syntax

Kind: `infix`, precedence 60, left-associative

```
{left: expr int} * {right: expr int} -> int
```

| `right` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`
